family: For every integer n>=0, f_n(x)=1 iff the Hamming weight of x is congruent to 0 modulo 3; f_0(empty)=1. This single total language has the fixed residue-scan polynomial-time evaluator and empty-witness NP verifier proved in proof.md.
theorem: In the full Li-Yang B2 model at actual input length n, C_B2(f_n)>=(7/3)*n-4 for every integer n>=2. Hence liminf over all integer lengths n of C_B2(f_n)/((7/3)*n)>=1. The finite coefficient/exponent projection is (7/3,1) for this same fixed family.
